owner_and_capability: Seventh slice of #4076: production ports that forced foreign types into tests now use the consumer's own vocabulary, bound at the root. Device Fleet display routes take a display-enabled function, Facilities reads activity group names through its own port, Timetable names the operational day's children as timetable.OperationStudent, School Calendar's mail and notification inputs use calendar types, Enrollment's root outbox fields take Enrollment's MailOutbox.
affected_tables: None: no DDL or table ownership change.
atomic_cutover: Code cutover without a new rule or policy epoch. api.DisplayFeatureEnabled binds settings.KeyDisplayEnabled; api.roomActivityNames binds the Facilities port to Timetable's ListGroups; api.NewTimetableOperationStudents fills timetable.OperationStudent from People Directory rows; api/calendar_portal.go wraps Delivery's outbox and notifications behind CalendarNotifier, CalendarReminderNotifier and CalendarPreferences with nil-preserving constructors (tenant id from tenant.FromContext, as before through TenantRuntime); EnrollmentIntakeSources, EnrollmentChangeRequestSources and EnrollmentRolloverSources take enrollmentCompose.MailOutbox, the production wiring wraps intakeMailOutbox(b.outbox()). Tests use testpkg fixtures, root test helpers and Workforce writes; assertions are unchanged. Composition surface 1720 -> 1664.
tests: Device Fleet display, Facilities room history, Timetable operations, School Calendar reminders, People Directory offboarding, Enrollment HTTP and Care Plan decision suites through test-changed.
scripts/run-go-toolchain.sh scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast; scripts/backend-architecture.sh check; validate-ticket --all.
